Blockchain is like a shared digital notebook that everyone can see but no one can secretly change. Instead of one person or company keeping the records, the information is spread out across many computers. Each page (or "block") holds a list of transactions. Once a page is filled and verified, it is locked in place using advanced math (cryptography) that ties it securely to the previous page. This makes it nearly impossible for anyone to alter past records or commit fraud.

The explorer who reached America in 1492 was Christopher Columbus.
